run_stylegan2_training_locally: run the StyleGAN2-ADA training script locally using argparse CLI arguments and optional JSON config
submit_stylegan2_training_to_slurm: submit a StyleGAN2-ADA training job to a Slurm cluster with GPU and node configuration
run_training_with_json_config: run the training script with parameters loaded from a JSON configuration file via the json_config argument
run_training_with_data_root: run training with data paths prefixed by a data_root directory for data, root_feats, and root_nns
review_trainer_class: review the Trainer class that extends Checkpointable and calls main for local or Slurm training
